messages.author: 767b3b657c071930
messages.subject: Nimble error
parts:
Hi.

I am trying to run a nested multilevel error -- this code worked fine in JAGS, but I'm getting an error message when I try using Nimble.

Any thoughts?

Thanks.

Jim

```{r}
d <- read.csv("http://personal.bgsu.edu/~albert/data/gateway.csv")
library(dplyr)
d$month <- as.numeric(d$Month)
d$year <- d$Year - 2002
```

```{r}
library(nimble)
```

```{r}
worshipCode <- nimbleCode({ 
  for (i in 1:N){
  y[i] ~ dpois(lambda[i])
  log(lambda[i]) <- mu + epsilon[i] + alpha[month[i]]
  epsilon[i] ~ dnorm(0, sd=sigma.y)
  }
  for (j in 1:J){
  alpha[j] ~ dnorm(0, sd=sigma.month)
}
mu ~ dnorm(0, sd=1000)
sigma.y ~ dunif(0, 100)
sigma.month ~ dunif(0, 100)
})
```

```{r}
worshipConsts <- list(N=484,
                      J=12,
                      K=10,
                      month=d$month)
worshipData <- list(y=d$Count)
worshipInits <- list(mu=5, sigma.y=.4, sigma.month=.4,
                     alpha=rep(0, 12))
```

```{r}
worship <- nimbleModel(code = worshipCode, name = 'worship', 
                    constants = worshipConsts,
                    data = worshipData,
                    inits=worshipInits)
```

I was able to run it too. By default nimbleModel() does some checking and alerts you if any variables are NA, just to be sure you know that not all values are set up and calculated yet. I see a message about that but otherwise it runs smoothly on my system.
Perry
